messages:
Jordan: Huge shoutout to @Priya and @Mark for sprinting on the new hire workstation setup this morning 44f saved onboarding from a rocky start.
Priya: Happy to help! Quick hack was to reupload the dotfiles and kick the provisioning job. :coffee:
Mark: Also swapped the bad USB hub in 3 mins. Who knew those things were cursed. :exploding_head:
Ellie: Can we get a kudos sticker or a tiny trophy for them? They showed up before 8am.
OnboardBot: Welcome checklist completed for @newhire-zoe. Note: workstation reprovisioned by @Priya, peripheral swap by @Mark.
Jordan: Dropping them a shout on the kudos board and forwarding to People Ops for a small thank-you card.
DevRel: I'll add them to the monthly "Helpers Hall" roundup in the newsletter. Also coffee voucher incoming. :coffee:
Priya: lol thanks! No need to make a big deal, but appreciated. Team effort.
Mark: If anyone wants the short USB hub horror log, I pasted it here:
```
lsusb
> Bus 002 Device 004: ID 1234:5678 USB Hub (faulty)
sudo dmesg | tail
> usb 2-1: hub port reset failed
```
Ellie: Saved the snippet. Adding a tiny note to the hardware runbook so we don't repeat this next week.
Jordan: Vote for reward: sticker :label: or coffee voucher :coffee:? (react with :one: or :two:)
Ellie: :one: sticker :grinning_face_with_star_eyes:
Priya: :two: coffee please :raised_hands:
Mark: :two: would be great, thanks!
Jordan: OK coffee voucher wins. Adding to People Ops request. Thanks again everyone for the quick pivot :)
